title: Isla's Quiet Day at the Library

segments.text: Here’s today’s Sapiver Press puzzle comic.
Isla steals a few moments of absolute stillness at the kitchen table before the day starts.
The steady hum of the train helps her focus on taking things one step at a time.
Sitting outside with her thoughts, she decides not to let the growing pressure get to her.
Check the daily rule before trusting it.
Tucked away in a steady corner, the pattern finally begins to make some actual sense.
Watching the rain slide down the glass, she feels a comfortable sense of steady satisfaction.
